name: Kanidm
description: Kanidm is a simple, secure identity management platform written in Rust, providing accounts, groups, and OAuth2/OIDC SSO plus a read-only LDAP gateway, with built-in replication for primary/backup deployments.

notes.text: Break-glass 'admin' and 'idm_admin' passwords are generated during install and saved to /root/kanidmd.creds inside the container.

domain/origin default to the container's hostname with a self-signed certificate. Edit /etc/kanidmd/server.toml and re-run 'kanidmd cert-generate' + 'kanidmd domain rename' before pointing real DNS at this host.
